_comment: Seed data for jrx.bar_council_config table — apply via SQL migration before activating A-149 to A-160
tableSchema: CREATE TABLE jrx.bar_council_config (config_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), jurisdiction VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, rule_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, rule_text TEXT NOT NULL, enforcement VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'WARN', active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, effective_from DATE, effective_to DATE, last_updated TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());

seedRules.rule_text: AI outputs must carry mandatory disclaimer that they do not constitute legal advice from an enrolled Advocate.
Agents must not generate content that solicits legal work or advertises services in a manner constituting touting.
AI-assisted billing estimates must be clearly marked as estimates, not fee agreements.
Agent must trigger conflict check before any matter-specific output. Conflict check result must be in IronLedger before first output.
References to IPC 1860, CrPC 1973, or IEA for post-July 2024 matters are prohibited — must use BNS/BNSS/BSA 2023.
AI outputs must be reviewed by a responsible solicitor before delivery to clients.
Agents assisting in litigation must not knowingly advance false contentions. Citation verification mandatory.
Agents assisting barrister advocacy must not mislead court or tribunal.
Agents assisting in court submissions must verify all cited cases exist — Mata v Avianca compliance mandatory.
Supervising attorney must review and take responsibility for all AI-generated work product.
Client data may not be input to third-party LLMs without client consent.
Client data must remain within UAE territory. CloudVault JCN-GCC routing to me-south-1 is a legal obligation. HTTP 451 on cross-region violation.
Outputs touching Sharia-governed matters must include mandatory disclosure of AI limitations in Sharia jurisprudence.
Clients have the right not to be subject to purely automated legal decisions with significant effect. HITL mandatory.
Mandatory human oversight for high-risk AI systems. HITL is a legal requirement under EU AI Act — cannot be disabled.
Agents assisting in Singapore court matters must not make misleading statements or present unverified citations.
Supervising lawyer must review AI outputs before delivery to client or court.
